task.title: P6-133: Fix two pager rendering edges - premature Back control and empty pagination nav
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Catalog, search and paging). Original id: P6-133. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**Two pager rendering edges** (was `P6-042c` + `P6-042d`): `paged` flips as soon as the URL moves, so during an in-flight Next the still-displayed page one grows a "← Back to the start" control before page two arrives (`catalog.rs:551`); and on a single-page result set an empty `<nav aria-label="Pagination">` renders — a named landmark with no content (`:550`).
